strengths.title: High Frontal Armour
strengths.description: With the low profile combined with excellent armour values, the object is a force to be reckoned with in close combat. Also able to collect scrap tokens which provide a means of passive healing, coupled with a high HP pool makes this tank particularly hard to kill.

strengths.title: Burst Damage Potential
strengths.description: Objects unique 2 round burst clips makes it a great tank for ambushing enemies. Being able to kill an enemy tank with 1 well placed clip makes this tank great for those that love flanking. A well timed strike and leave an enemy in respawn before they can even react to you.

strengths.title: Great at Isolation
strengths.description: The Object's abilities makes him a bad match for most tanks to face in an 1v1. Combining Combat cage and harpoon makes it hard for an enemy to escape, You are very adept at securing important kills or picking off isolated opponents.

weaknesses.title: Overall Mobility and Speed
weaknesses.description: The 287 isn't a fast vehicle. A top speed of 57 and a reverse speed of only 15km/h means this vehicle has only one real choice. Forward. Once in a fight, the 287 is likely there until its over.

weaknesses.title: High Energy Cost
weaknesses.description: The Object 287 can be very energy hungry. With a reliance on its abilities to make the most in aggressive CQB the 287 can quickly deplete its energy reserves, making it harder to play in prolonged engagements

weaknesses.title: Accidental Overextension
weaknesses.description: One of the greatest threats to the Object 287 is its own playstyle. Its abilities heavily encourage aggressive, point-blank engagements, often drawing commanders deep into enemy lines. Players who fail to keep track of the wider battle or over-commit to a target may quickly find themselves isolated in the middle of the enemy team with limited options for escape and multiple guns focused on them.

weaknesses.title: Weak Side Armour
weaknesses.description: Even though the 287 has good frontal Armor, It's sides are token at best. Showing your sides or back of the tank invites easy critical hits from an enemy. 287 commanders must make sure to keep on the move and actively work to mitigate this weakness.

tank_summary: The Object 287 is an aggressive close-quarters attacker that excels at disrupting enemy formations and punishing isolated targets. Combining strong acceleration, a low profile, and a surprisingly large hit-point pool, it has the tools needed to force engagements on its own terms. Its harpoon and Tank Cage abilities work together to trap opponents, making it difficult for enemies to disengage once the fight has begun.

At close range, the 287 becomes exceptionally dangerous. Its rapid-firing auto-cannon is capable of tearing through distracted or damaged vehicles in seconds, while its harpoon can be used to set up devastating rams and prevent targets from escaping. The vehicle's low height further enhances its effectiveness in brawls, as opponents may struggle to depress their guns enough to land reliable return fire. In the hands of an aggressive commander, the 287 can quickly turn a small opening into a decisive advantage.

However, the Object 287 demands careful positioning and situational awareness. Its 8-second interclip reload leaves large windows for enemies to retaliate, and the vehicle lacks any form of sacrificial armour, meaning every hit it takes deals its full potential damage. Combined with the lowest reverse speed in the game, over-committing can be fatal. Commanders who lose track of the battle or push too deeply into enemy lines may find themselves trapped without an escape route, making the 287 a vehicle that rewards aggression, but punishes recklessness.
